name: QPS Holdings Inc.
summary: QPS Holdings Inc. engages in the earth observation satellite data business in Japan. The company research and development, design, manufacture, sale, operation, management, and maintenance of satellites, satellite-mounted equipment, precision equipment, electronic equipment, ground facilities, software, and information and communication networks. It is also involved in business related to data acquired by satellites; provision of services using artificial satellites; planning and operation of training sessions, workshops, and seminars regarding space technologies; and technical consulting, operational support, contract work, development guidance, lectures, education, and related to satellite…
